summary: runWithTimeout(fn, ms) runs fn through a shared vm.Script trampoline ('out = fn()') with runInContext's timeout. Node's watchdog for that timeout runs on a separate thread and terminates execution, so it stops a synchronous spin in main-context JS, regex or wasm (verified for all three) while setTimeout/signal handlers could not run. ERR_SCRIPT_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT becomes ParseTimeoutError; other errors are rethrown unchanged. Default 5s (DEFAULT_PARSE_TIMEOUT_MS), overridable via COLDSTART_PARSE_TIMEOUT_MS, read per call so tests can change it. Measured cost ~60µs per call.
